text:
Zoe Chen: Rooftop gaming tonight? Thinking of doing a hybrid setup — one local PC + projector, Steam Remote Play for folks who want low-latency co-op, and Parsec for remote teammates. Who can bring an ethernet switch and a capture card? Also we need a few power strips.

Samir P: I can bring an 8-port gigabit switch and a bunch of short patch cables. Not sure about capture though.

Kelly R: I have 2 power strips and snacks (vegan cookies). I'll bring duct tape and gaffer for run-covering. :cookie: :tada:

Arjun S: I have a cheap USB3 capture dongle (Elgato-ish) that works fine for the projector hookup. Can also bring a couple of controllers.

Maya (events): I'll post a quick invite + map in #events. What time? 7pm or 8pm? Also can we do a tiny poll for game picks?

Zoe Chen: @Maya (events) 7pm works. Poll for games: 1) Overcooked 2, 2) Rocket League, 3) Jackbox, 4) co-op indie (enter suggestions). Remote-friendly picks are preferred.

Samir P: Quick networking note — rooftop Wi‑Fi is spotty. Recommend plugging the projector PC into the switch and letting us hotspot the switch uplink to the AP, or just tether a phone as backup.

Arjun S: For anyone running Parsec/Remote Play, set this on the host before the event if you want NAT traversal to behave: ```sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1``` and make sure UPnP on the router is on. (We can help with config on-site.)

Kelly R: I'll take the Jackbox slot if people want party games. :joy:

Maya (events): partybot:poll "Start time" "7pm" "8pm"

partybot: Poll created: "Start time" — 7pm (2), 8pm (1).

Zoe Chen: Awesome. Logistics check: @Samir P — thanks for switch. @Arjun S — capture + controllers = lifesaver. @Kelly R — snacks and Jackbox legend. See y'all at 7! :rocket:

Samir P: I'll text if I'm running late. Anyone need a ride up with gear?

Arjun S: I can haul the projector cables if needed.

Kelly R: I'll bring an extra ethernet cable for the router uplink. :+1:

Maya (events): Posted invite + roof access code in the event. Reminder: bring warm layers, it's breezy up there.

Zoe Chen: Last thing — can someone capture a quick highlight clip for the channel? short 30s clip for the #random feed would be awesome.

Arjun S: Yep I'll snag a clip.

Samir P: See you tonight. :party_popper:
